user_question: Create a raster showing the elevation difference between the two elevation surfaces available for State College.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Create a raster showing the elevation difference between the two elevation surfaces available for State College.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve second elevation surface
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain the other available elevation surface covering State College.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a candidate elevation raster for State College and exclude the already supplied artifact. Runtime QC must verify that the returned candidate is an elevation raster with suitable State College spatial coverage and GeoTIFF format.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject second elevation surface
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the retrieved elevation surface into the known metric CRS of input_1 before grid alignment and raster arithmetic.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the retrieved elevation surface to EPSG:26918, preserving elevation values. If the candidate CRS is genuinely unknown, route clarification through runtime QC rather than inferring it.

workflow_steps.title: Align second elevation raster grid
workflow_steps.purpose: Resample the reprojected elevation surface to the 30 m grid of input_1 so raster arithmetic is valid.
workflow_steps.instructions: Resample the reprojected elevation surface using input_1 as the reference grid, targeting 30 m resolution and matching its extent, origin, dimensions, and CRS. Preserve the elevation surface for subsequent subtraction.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate elevation difference
workflow_steps.purpose: Create the requested raster showing the cell-by-cell elevation difference between the two elevation surfaces.
workflow_steps.instructions: Calculate the elevation difference using input_1 minus elevation_surface_aligned, with input_1 as the reference grid. Preserve nodata handling according to the raster calculation contract.

requirements.scope: The retrieved elevation surface must cover the State College area requested by the user.
The retrieved candidate must be available as a GeoTIFF raster suitable for raster processing.
The retrieved elevation raster must have a known source CRS before reprojection.
The reprojected elevation surface must be a GeoTIFF raster.
The resampled elevation surface must match input_1 in CRS, extent, origin, dimensions, and pixel alignment.
The resampled elevation surface and input_1 must use compatible CRSs.
The aligned elevation surface must have no coarser pixel size than the 30 m reference resolution of input_1 and must be configured to the reference 30 m grid.
The aligned elevation surface must be a GeoTIFF raster accepted by raster_calculator.
Both input rasters must have compatible CRSs for raster arithmetic.
Both input rasters must have compatible grid definitions for cell-by-cell subtraction.
Both input rasters must be GeoTIFF rasters accepted by raster_calculator.
